elements.name: two young men seen from behind in the centre
young man in denim jacket carrying nothing
five Ethiopian men crowding and gesturing with open hands
faces of the crowding men in deep shadow or turned away

notes: Remove the backpack from the denim-jacket man and make him slightly taller than the backpack man. Put the backpack man in dark closed-toe plastic sandals instead of brown shoes.
